topic_rules.label: Gas Prices

topic_rules.label: Elections

meta.dedupe_rule: one swing per ticker per 15 minutes (direction-independent); cross-detector repeats collapse within 3 minutes
meta.dedupe_reapplied_note: Alert rows were re-de-duplicated offline with the engine's own collapseDuplicates(); no row was invented or re-priced, and meta.generated_at is still the timestamp of the API sample these rows came from. The next tools/live_engine.mjs run performs the same step as part of its normal write.
